cards.body:
Drivers face significant delays at the intersection of Pratt Whitney and Bridge Roads in Martin County during morning and afternoon commute hours. The rural four-way stop backs up with commuters, particularly when accidents occur.

 Many of those drivers travel from places like Lake Okeechobee and Pahokee. Workers who live far from their jobs in search of affordable housing make the long commute.

 The intersection has received upgraded signs, rumble strips, and advanced warning signs. Installing a full traffic light requires meeting state thresholds for high traffic volumes or crash data. The county has studied widening the road in phases.

cards.headline: 17 businesses raise over $10,000 for Sebastian River High play clocks after coach's Facebook post
cards.teaser: Seventeen local businesses raised more than $10,000 for new play clocks at Sebastian River High School after coach Phinehas Weatherly posted about equipment problems on Facebook.
cards.body:
Seventeen local businesses raised more than $10,000 for new play clocks at Sebastian River High School after coach Phinehas Weatherly posted about equipment problems on Facebook.

 Weatherly said the varsity football program has struggled with malfunctioning play clocks for four years. Each repair cost thousands of dollars.
